name: Kaltz
source:
One of the four devils out to devour Konoe, although he lacks a passion to do so. His demeanor and behavior is unique among the devils, and he even goes as far as to show concern for Konoe. He's a gloomy devil who prefers to be alone and keep conversations brief. He can manipulate ice.

 [Based on [url=http://lamento.wikia.com/wiki/Kaltz]Lamento Wiki[/url] & [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamento_-BEYOND_THE_VOID-]Wikipedia[/url]]
